corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Malpass constructs a structurally matched counterpossibility: impersonal indeterministic causation can supply origination without antecedent necessitation, undermining the claim that such flexibility uniquely indicates libertarian personality. Principal limitation: The comparison establishes underdetermination rather than equivalence, because it does not explain an impersonal indeterministic first cause, nor exclude agency-specific explanatory advantages. Live burden: Craig must identify and defend some discriminating feature beyond timing flexibility that favors personal agency, while Malpass must show his alternative is metaphysically intelligible enough to remain competitive rather than merely verbally conceivable. Locked score: The very strong 91 appropriately reflects exceptional relevance, coherence, qualification, and charitable diagnostic force, tempered by the comparatively thinner warrant supporting the rival cause itself.
